title: Queue panel: a generic row for non-GPU jobs (CPU, ffmpeg, file copy) with a progress bar
description: UMBRELLA: MPI-1102 - No silent work: every job shows in the queue (umbrella) (consolidation sweep 2026-10-12). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-1102/plan.md. Transfers in MpiQueuePanel (MPI-1057) shows only state.downloadJobs / state.uploadJobs. There is no row for a CPU job (ffmpeg, sharp, a file copy, a cleanup). Build one shared path: a job registers, gets a row with an MpiProgressBar (real % when known, the mpi-progress--loading sweep when not), shows done / failed / cancelled, and leaves. Every other member that moves a non-GPU action into the queue depends on this. Never the status bar: that is GPU only.
